name: 🔥 Buy $500+ SPX → Earn 1% Daily
description:
Buy at least $500 of SPX with your own wallet and hold your qualifying SPX for at least 24 hours.

Once your 24-hour holding period is completed, you can earn 1% of your qualifying purchase amount in SPX every 24 hours, for up to 30 days.

Example: $500 SPX purchase → $5 SPX daily reward → up to $150 over 30 days.

Your purchase and holding period are verified on-chain.

Important: The 1% daily SPX reward is paid automatically to your wallet by the ShopinX reward system. This is separate from any XP or other platform rewards shown here.

How it works:

1. Connect your BNB Chain wallet.
2. Complete the purchase verification.
3. Buy $500+ of SPX.
4. Hold your qualifying SPX for at least 24 hours.
5. Receive your daily SPX reward automatically.

Details: https://shopinx.io/creator-earn

name: Install Hive Calls & Become a Buzzer 🐝
description:
Call your friends, have natural conversations, and help improve voice AI.

Complete this Galxe quest to unlock the Buzzer role in the DataHive Discord. You and your friends can also earn DataHive points for a future airdrop through approved calls.

Available worldwide on Android and iPhone. Talk in any language!

How it works
1. [Install Hive Calls](https://dhive.app) and connect your DataHive account.
2. Complete the quest to claim your Buzzer Discord role.
3. Invite a friend through the app or share your invite link.
4. Call each other and talk naturally. Both of you earn points for approved minutes.

Talk about anything you normally would with a friend: work, travel, hobbies, plans, stories, or just catching up.

No scripts or assigned topics. Reading aloud, monologues, scripted conversations, and discussions about DataHive, Hive Calls, or earning points do not qualify for points.

Recording and privacy

Calls are recorded only after both participants agree. Approved recordings may be licensed to AI companies for training and testing voice AI.

Your account phone number, email, and contact list are not included in customer datasets. Avoid sharing sensitive information during recorded calls.

*Join the hive, claim your Buzzer role, and make your voice count!*
